toolsShaIsNotHead: toolsSha is T1, the final orchestration commit -- NOT this commit and not the branch tip. The hosted workflow may execute from a later HEAD, and a dispatch tools_sha equal to github.sha is a different concept from this binding. Binding to HEAD would be self-reference: the record would certify whatever tree happened to contain it.

The previous binding named the MVLP-era tuple 436520e4 / sha256:98e3e820 and tools 0aed58be4, which PREDATES the successor freeze -- the successor freeze is not an ancestor of it, so the binding was stale by a release generation. The delta is recomputed from git, not hand-listed, and every path in it is individually named in the verifier bounded set: no prefix, no pattern, unknown tooling still refuses.
